message.content: According to the conversation, Viper plans to incorporate interval training into their cardio routines. This method involves alternating periods of high-intensity exercise with lower-intensity recovery periods. Viper notes that this technique is effective for building endurance without overworking the body. They suggest starting with shorter intervals and gradually increasing the duration and intensity of these sessions as one becomes more comfortable with the routine. Viper found that this approach has significantly improved their stamina.
